topic: Data API readiness and sandbox issues
summary_markdown: The data API is ready, but the new fields are currently added to existing v3 reports and JCD, not a new endpoint. The fields have not been deployed yet. A discussion occurred regarding writing new data into these existing reports. Separately, [p1] accidentally deleted sandbox ClickHouse data volumes after running 'gravitron' machines, which was noted as being recoverable and even useful for schema testing.
decisions: New fields will be added to existing v3 reports and JCD (pending confirmation).
